name: Koi Autumn Pond
description: A Japanese garden pond seen from above in golden autumn light. Koi glide in slow loops, dive and rise to sip at the surface, maple leaves tumble down and ripple the water before drifting and sinking, sun rays and caustics play over the pebbled floor, and a red wooden bridge crosses between mossy stones. Optional dusk with glowing stone lanterns and light rain. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
